content: https://github.com/leanprover/cslib/pull/424 proves soundness of linear sequent calculus wrt phase semantics, and proves completeness for the multiplicative-additive fragment (no ! or ? modalities). Getting completeness of full CLL requires giving the phase semantics additional structure to interpret the modalities. this could make a good next step so I left as a TODO.
@Chris Henson I went thru and cleaned this up some more, let me know if you have more thoughts
